GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (18 Feb 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 753)
APO 500
18 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Japanese Nationals in Manchuria.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. Petition to General Douglas MacArthur, dated 15 February 1946, from Liaison Association of Enterprisers and Industrialists in Manchuria (unofficial) residing in Tokyo, copy appended hereto.
b. Memorandum from this headquarters, file AG 370.05 (17 Feb 46)GC, (SCAPIN - 747), dated 17 February 1946, subject: "Protection and Repatriation of Japanese in Northern Korea, Manchuria, the Kurile Islands and Sakhalin."
2. The matter of relief and repatriation of Japanese nationals in Manchuria has already been referred to the United States Government for appropriate action.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will be notified when arrangements have been made for repatriation from Manchuria or for the resumption of postal service to that area.
4. The Imperial Japanese Government will bring the contents of this memorandum to the attention of the Liaison Association of Enterprisers and Industrialists in Manchuria (unofficial) residing in Tokyo.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
1 Incl. - as indicated above.
